description.value:
This short cape is made of wilting roses sewn into red velvet and lined with thorned stems that dig into the skin. Whenever the Boneyard is denied a new soul, a cape of blood roses calls its wearer to balance the scales of life and death and guarantee that someone makes their way into the afterlife.

Activate—Swift Sanguine r

Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature you can see recovers from the dying condition

Effect The thorns of the corsage prick the skin of your back and shoulders, demanding a new death. You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Quickened] until the end of your next turn and can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.
